purposes.ASIF Document: Root of an immutable session capture. Collections describe identity, history, effective context, resources and known state; coverage explains their limits.
purposes.Capture: Identifies this immutable observation of a logical session and explains its capture boundary.
purposes.Producer: Identifies the software that created the capture, including its version.
purposes.Session: Identifies the logical interaction across captures, with its objective and lineage.
purposes.Native Identifier: Preserves an opaque identifier in a provider's namespace without making it an ASIF identity.
purposes.Lineage: Relates this session to the source of a continuation, fork, translation or copy.
purposes.Event Reference: Names a local event or explicitly names an event in another session capture. It never causes an automatic fetch.
purposes.Text Part: Carries exact Unicode text at one position in ordered content.
purposes.Resource Part: Places an attachment or other resource at one position in ordered content; availability belongs to the Resource Object.
purposes.Structured Part: Carries JSON whose interpretation is defined by a named schema. Unknown schemas remain opaque.
purposes.Opaque Part: Preserves a resource whose semantic interpretation is unavailable to this reader.
purposes.Provenance: Distinguishes observed, reported, derived and synthetic evidence and identifies its sources.
purposes.Provenance Source: Identifies a source resource and, optionally, a specific span or structured location within it.
purposes.Source Locator: Selects bytes or a structured location within a provenance source; unknown syntaxes remain uninterpreted.
purposes.Participant: Identifies a person, agent, tool or service independently of the role used in a particular message.
purposes.Participant Child Session: Names a delegated participant's separate session capture; its history is not implicitly included.
purposes.Execution: Records an agent activity interval and its observed state, model contexts and optional usage.
purposes.Execution Model: Retains the model settings recorded for an execution. Provider-specific values require a declared interpretation before reuse.
purposes.Tool: Defines a callable interface, including its JSON Schema input contract. A definition does not implement the tool.
purposes.Instruction: Records instruction content, source, scope and activation without inventing unknown precedence.
purposes.Instruction Scope: Preserves a source dialect's scope declaration. Portable scope bindings are defined by the continuation profile.
purposes.Instruction Activation: Preserves a source dialect's activation declaration. Portable activation bindings are defined by the continuation profile.
purposes.Capability: Describes a skill, plugin, hook, connection or other runtime facility and its supporting resources.
purposes.Policy: Records a named policy dialect and whether its restrictions were enforced.
purposes.Configuration: An immutable snapshot of instructions, capabilities, policies and credential prerequisites.
purposes.Configuration Secret Requirements: Names a credential prerequisite using a logical handle and purpose. Credential values do not belong here.
purposes.Configuration Model: Retains configuration-level model settings; a context can identify the settings used for a particular request.
purposes.Requirement: States a prerequisite and the capabilities for which it matters, including whether its resolution is known.
purposes.Environment: Describes a workspace, service or runtime environment and its dependencies without granting access to it.
purposes.Environment Definition: Preserves environment-specific data under an explicit dialect identifier.
purposes.Resource: Describes attachment or dependency identity, availability and integrity. Embedded text, base64 and file-backed resources share the same decoded-byte semantics.
purposes.Context Input: One resolved, ordered input to a model: a message, tool call or tool result, with source attribution.
purposes.Context: Records or proposes the actual ordered model input independently of conversation and branch order.
purposes.Context Model: Retains the model identity and settings associated with this context.
purposes.Context Request Parameters: Retains request settings associated with this exact context; unknown provider parameters are not silently translated.
purposes.Branch: Selects an ordered conversation history and its head within this capture.
purposes.Branch Fork: Records the source branch boundary at which histories diverged. It does not imply a filesystem rewind.
purposes.Checkpoint: Records known state at a selected branch boundary, including unresolved calls, decisions and task revisions.
purposes.Open Call: Records a call whose outcome remains unresolved at the checkpoint; it does not authorize replay.
purposes.Open Decision: Records an unresolved decision at the checkpoint; absence of a resolution is not consent.
purposes.Task State: Selects the current revision of a recorded task at a checkpoint.
purposes.Usage: Attributes a measured or reported counter to an explicit scope, unit and provenance.
purposes.Event: Immutable envelope for a recorded occurrence, including identity, attribution, causality and kind-specific data.
purposes.Event Data: Discriminated payload selected by the enclosing Event Object's `kind`. Use the corresponding event data object below.
purposes.Extension Map: Carries namespaced extension values without changing the meaning of core fields.
purposes.Message Data: A conversation message whose role is separate from the event actor's identity.
purposes.Tool Call Data: One logical invocation and its known arguments. Partial arguments cannot be executed as a completed call.
purposes.Tool Result Data: One indexed result for a correlated call, including its terminal marker and outcome.
purposes.Decision Request Data: A question, approval or review request, optionally bound to a call or an exact task revision.
purposes.Decision Request Option: A selectable answer with a stable ID within its decision request.
purposes.Decision Resolution Data: Records the outcome of the exact referenced request. Historical approval does not authorize a receiving runtime.
purposes.Task Update Data: A versioned task state, with optional predecessor and dependency declarations.
purposes.Context Checkpoint Data: Records the selection or replacement of a context, including a compaction boundary.
purposes.Configuration Change Data: Records a new configuration snapshot; effective use is determined by referencing contexts and executions.
purposes.Execution Transition Data: Records an observed execution lifecycle transition without claiming a process is still alive.
purposes.Resource Change Data: Records creation, modification, deletion or observation of a resource identity.
purposes.Note Data: Explanatory content with no implicit execution or authorization meaning.
purposes.Extension Data: An event with namespaced semantics; required interpretation is also advertised in `required_features`.
purposes.Coverage: Declares the completeness or known absence of one session domain. An empty collection alone makes no completeness claim.
purposes.Loss: Discloses information omitted or changed during capture, normalization, redaction or translation.
purposes.Loss References: Identifies an entity affected by a loss using its entity type and ID.
purposes.Stream Segment: Selects an exact byte slice of a captured resource and its position in a logical stream.
purposes.Stream: Binds incremental argument or text-result bytes to a core event. A complete stream must agree with that event's assembled value.
purposes.External Binding: Binds an invocation or decision request from an earlier capture to its immutable source boundary and descriptor.
purposes.External Binding Source: Names the exact source event of an external call or request; no external data is fetched implicitly.
purposes.External Binding Descriptor: Discriminated descriptor selected by the enclosing external binding's `kind`.
purposes.External Call Descriptor: Preserves the tool and argument contract of an invocation outside the included event history.
purposes.External Request Descriptor: Preserves the kind, prompt and options of a decision request outside the included event history.
purposes.Continuation Profile: Optional declarations needed to assess continuation from a session checkpoint. It contains no runtime authorization.
purposes.Agent: Names an agent implementation, version and native state format.
purposes.Runtime: Identifies the agent, adapter and operating platform involved in a continuation assessment.
purposes.Runtime Adapter: Names the adapter implementation and version used to interpret native state.
purposes.Model: Identifies a model provider, model ID and optional known revision without assuming equivalence to another model.
purposes.Workspace Entry: One selected filesystem entry. File bytes are resources; link targets are declarations requiring a destination link policy.
purposes.Git State: Describes Git identity, index stages, object prerequisites, submodules and LFS dependencies separately from working-tree bytes.
purposes.Git Prerequisites: Declares a Git object required to interpret or restore the captured state.
purposes.Git Index Entries: Records one index path and stage, preserving conflicts rather than collapsing them into working-tree content.
purposes.Git Submodules: Pins a submodule path and commit and names the dependency needed to resolve it.
purposes.Workspace: A selected filesystem snapshot, delta or reference declaration bound to a session boundary and logical root.
purposes.Workspace Selection: Defines the selected portion of a workspace and whether it is complete within that selection.
purposes.Tool Behavior: Describes a versioned tool behavior contract, including effects and replay semantics.
purposes.Dependency: A runtime, tool, capability or other dependency with explicit version, platform and transitive requirements.
purposes.Dependency Platform: Declares the operating systems and architectures on which the dependency is accepted.
purposes.Dependency Binding: Describes how a dependency is expected to be resolved without installing or fetching it automatically.
purposes.Scope: A portable instruction scope: global, a logical root or a path prefix within that root.
purposes.Activation: An unconditional activation or a predicate in an explicitly named dialect.
purposes.Configuration Binding: Connects a configuration to explicit instruction order, interpretation rules and policy identities.
purposes.Configuration Binding Instruction Rules: Declares one instruction's authority, merge behavior, priority, scope and activation.
purposes.Service Binding: Describes the service identity and access prerequisites that a destination must resolve separately.
purposes.Service Endpoint: A recorded service locator or destination-resolved endpoint declaration.
purposes.Service Account: Identifies the expected account without including credentials.
purposes.Operation: Records an external or local operation whose outcome or recovery affects continuation.
purposes.Operation External Identity: Names an operation in an external system without treating its identifier as proof of status.
purposes.Operation Recovery: Declares a recovery strategy and its required handler, idempotency binding and evidence.
purposes.Native Import: Describes a native-state import contract, including ordering, indexes, identity and conflicts.
purposes.Native Adapter: Names the adapter responsible for interpreting this native import contract.
purposes.Context Accounting: Explains how one branch event is represented, summarized, excluded or unavailable in the selected context.
purposes.Next Action: Declares the intended next interaction after prerequisites and destination authorization are resolved.
purposes.Continuation Plan: Selects one checkpoint, context, configuration and dependency closure for a particular continuation attempt.
purposes.Plan Boundary: Describes how the source boundary was captured consistently and identifies supporting evidence.
purposes.Plan Cwd: Names the working directory relative to a selected logical workspace root.
purposes.Plan Path References: Maps one explicitly selected string field to a logical root and relative path; it never triggers global string replacement.
purposes.Plan Model Requirements: Declares the source model, required capabilities and media types, and overflow handling.
purposes.Destination Report: An expiring assessment bound to exact source bytes and a particular destination. Synthetic reports cannot claim execution.
purposes.Source: Binds this report to a source session, capture, continuation plan and exact document digest.
purposes.Destination: Identifies the assessed destination runtime and the digest of its capability snapshot.
purposes.Path Bindings: Maps one logical root to a destination path and declares the destination's path comparison rules.
purposes.Identity Mappings: Records an explicit mapping of a source entity identity into the destination namespace.
purposes.Model Assessment: Reports the target model and measured or unknown context fit, including reserved output capacity.
purposes.Blocking Reasons: Explains a subject-specific condition preventing the selected continuation plan from being ready.
purposes.Import Result: Records whether native import was attempted and the evidence for its outcome.
purposes.Continuation Result: Records whether continuation was tested and the evidence for its outcome.
purposes.Subject: Identifies the exact entity or capability being assessed, including its owner where IDs are scoped.
purposes.Assessment: Records support, adaptation or a blocker for one subject, with evidence and any resolved binding.
purposes.Assessment Resolved: Carries the destination's resolved dependency or service binding for comparison with source requirements.
purposes.Assessment Resolved Account: Identifies the resolved destination account for comparison with the expected service account.
purposes.Evidence: Identifies the producer, time and kind of evidence supporting an assessment or execution result.
purposes.Transformation: Declares a proposed or accepted adaptation, its target, rule, losses and acceptance evidence.
purposes.Result: Common result shape for an attempted import or continuation operation, including explanatory evidence.
purposes.External Request Option: One selectable option of an externally bound decision request.

fields.id: Opaque, case-sensitive identity within the object's declared scope.
fields.type: Namespaced semantic type or entity type, as defined by the enclosing object.
fields.name: Recorded name; identity is carried separately by the ID.
fields.value: Value interpreted according to the enclosing schema, dialect or counter.
fields.detail: Explanation of the stated status or evidence.
fields.explanation: Reason for the declaration or limitation.
fields.reason: Reason for the recorded operation or unavailable interpretation.
fields.status: Recorded state at the relevant boundary; see the allowed values.
fields.state: Recorded pending or observed state; it is not a live process assertion.
fields.mode: Representation or interpretation mode selected by the enclosing object.
fields.purpose: Intended use of the record or resource.
fields.required: Whether this subject is required for the selected capability.
fields.required_for: Capabilities that depend on this prerequisite.
fields.required_features: Feature identifiers whose semantics a consumer must understand for its capability claim.
fields.asif_version: Exact ASIF draft version used by this document.
fields.capture: Immutable capture identity and observation boundary.
fields.session: Logical session identity, objective and lineage.
fields.participants: Declared actors referenced by the captured interaction.
fields.events: Immutable captured occurrences in serialization order.
fields.tools: Callable tool definitions referenced by activity or context.
fields.resources: Attachments, artifacts, memory and supporting resources.
fields.checkpoints: State observations at branch boundaries, including each captured head.
fields.coverage: One completeness declaration for every required session domain.
fields.losses: Explicit information changes or omissions; empty means none declared.
fields.usage: Recorded counters with scope, units and provenance.
fields.continuation: Optional portable-continuation profile, gated by its required feature identifier.
fields.external_bindings: Optional prior-capture call/request descriptors, gated by `asif.external-bindings/0.1`.
fields.producer: Software or instrumentation responsible for the capture or evidence.
fields.consistency: Whether the captured boundary is known to be consistent.
fields.boundary: Explanation or structured declaration of the observation boundary.
fields.started_at: Recorded start time; omitted when unknown.
fields.ended_at: Recorded end time; omitted when unknown.
fields.time: Recorded observation time; it does not define causality.
fields.title: Human-readable session title.
fields.objective: Recorded session objective as ordered content parts.
fields.native_ids: Original IDs, each qualified by provider and namespace.
fields.lineage: Explicit relationships to source sessions and captures.
fields.provider: Provider identity for the named object or account.
fields.namespace: Namespace in which the opaque value is meaningful.
fields.relation: Relationship to the referenced source session.
fields.session_id: Logical session ID of the referenced boundary.
fields.capture_id: Immutable capture ID of the referenced boundary.
fields.event_id: Event identity, resolved locally unless an external capture is explicit.
fields.inclusive: Whether the referenced boundary event is included.
fields.text: Exact Unicode text; embedded-resource bytes use UTF-8.
fields.media_type: Declared media type of the content or resource.
fields.resource_id: ID of the referenced Resource Object.
fields.schema: Identifier of the schema that gives the structured value meaning.
fields.semantic_type: Namespaced meaning of content whose interpretation is unavailable.
fields.sources: Original resource locations supporting this provenance.
fields.locator: Location interpreted according to its declared syntax or availability.
fields.offset: Zero-based byte offset into the referenced resource.
fields.length: Number of bytes in the selected span.
fields.method: Method used to derive, synthesize or capture this record.
fields.inputs: Ordered inputs; provenance inputs identify supporting events.
fields.parent_participant_id: ID of the parent or delegating participant.
fields.native_id: Opaque participant identity in its source system.
fields.child_session: Explicit reference to a delegated session capture.
fields.participant_id: ID of the participant responsible for the execution.
fields.context_ids: IDs of contexts associated with this execution.
fields.model: Recorded model identity or settings for this scope.
fields.error: Captured error evidence; its contents do not establish a recovery action.
fields.input_schema: JSON Schema 2020-12 contract for tool arguments; `true` declares no known restriction.
fields.output_schema: Optional JSON Schema contract for tool output.
fields.server_identity: Recorded identity of the tool server.
fields.revision: Versioned definition or task revision within its identity.
fields.resource_ids: IDs of supporting resources; their availability is declared separately.
fields.parts: Ordered content parts. Order is semantically significant.
fields.scope: Domain or activation scope to which this declaration applies.
fields.activation: Conditions under which an instruction or rule applies.
fields.dialect: Identifier of the language used to interpret the associated value.
fields.definition: Dialect-specific definition retained without guessing unknown semantics.
fields.enforcing: Whether this policy enforces restrictions rather than providing advice.
fields.instructions: Recorded instruction sequence; effective order must be known before equivalent continuation.
fields.capabilities: Required or declared abilities for this configuration or model.
fields.secret_requirements: Logical credential handles and purposes; no credential values.
fields.knowledge: How much of the effective state or configuration is known.
fields.environment_ids: IDs of environments required by this configuration.

fields.capability_id: Referenced capability identity within the applicable configuration.
fields.secret_handle: Logical credential handle referenced by this requirement.
fields.availability: Whether and how the referenced content is available.
fields.original_location: Source location retained as metadata; not permission to access it.

fields.path: Portable relative path within the declared resource or workspace root.
fields.role: Message role used for this input, independently of participant identity.
fields.source_events: Events from which this resolved input was obtained.
fields.transformation: Explanation of a known change from source content.
fields.call_id: Session-scoped identity of one logical invocation.
fields.tool_id: ID of the referenced tool definition.
fields.arguments: Exact known JSON argument value; completeness is declared separately.
fields.arguments_status: Whether the known arguments are complete, partial or unknown.
fields.result_index: Monotonically increasing result position within the call's selected history.
fields.terminal: Whether this is the final result or fragment in its declared scope.
fields.outcome: Recorded result or assessment outcome; unknown remains explicit.

fields.fidelity: How closely this context represents the known model input.
fields.tool_ids: IDs of tools made available to this context.
fields.configuration_id: ID of the configuration snapshot used at this boundary.
fields.request_parameters: Recorded request settings; unknown provider-specific semantics are not inferred.
fields.event_ids: Ordered, duplicate-free selection of included event IDs.

fields.fork: Explicit source boundary for a branch fork.
fields.context_id: ID of the selected Context Object.
fields.open_calls: Unresolved invocation identities at this checkpoint.
fields.open_decisions: Unresolved decision-request identities at this checkpoint.
fields.tasks: Task revision selections at this checkpoint.
fields.request_id: Session-scoped identity of the exact decision request.
fields.scope_id: Identity of the entity to which the counter applies.

fields.actor_id: ID of the participant responsible for the event.

fields.workspaces: Workspace state declarations, including referenced delta bases.
fields.configuration_bindings: Portable interpretation bindings for configuration snapshots.
fields.operations: Operations whose state or recovery matters to continuation.
fields.plans: Selections of a checkpoint and its continuation prerequisites.
fields.agent: Agent implementation, version and state format.

session:/$defs/execution/properties/mode.rules: This is an open map. Preserve unknown values. Reuse requires support for their declared semantics; an empty map does not prove that the source had no hidden settings.

fields.data: Base64 encoding of the embedded resource bytes.
fields.path: Portable relative path resolved against the session document or package root.
fields.locator: External resource locator. Reading the document MUST NOT fetch it automatically.

session:/$defs/resource.rules: See [resource rules](../SEMANTICS.md#10-resources-and-availability). Embedded resources MUST select exactly one of `text`, `data` and `path`, with verified decoded `bytes` and `sha256`. Other availability states MUST explain the limitation; external resources also require a locator.

session:/$defs/context/properties/model.rules: This is an open map. Preserve unknown values. Reuse requires support for their declared semantics; an empty map does not prove that the source had no hidden settings.

session:/$defs/context/properties/reques.rules: This is an open map. Preserve unknown values. Reuse requires support for their declared semantics; an empty map does not prove that the source had no hidden settings.

session:/$defs/event.rules: See [event rules](../SEMANTICS.md#5-event-envelope-ordering-and-content). The enclosing `kind` selects one of the event-data objects below. Local causal edges MUST be acyclic and point to earlier serialized events.

session:/$defs/event/properties/extensio.rules: This is an open map. Preserve unknown values. Reuse requires support for their declared semantics; an empty map does not prove that the source had no hidden settings.

session:/$defs/event/allOf/1/then/proper.rules: See [tool-call progression rules](../SEMANTICS.md#tool-call-progression-across-captures). A partial or unknown invocation can gain arguments through a new event with local `supersedes`, retaining its call/tool/actor/execution/retry identity. Completed calls cannot be amended through this mechanism; retries use a new call ID. Selected histories must choose a single amendment chain. These are inter-event semantic checks beyond JSON Schema.

session:/$defs/event/allOf/5/then/proper.rules: See [selected-history state transitions](../SEMANTICS.md#15-selected-history-state-transitions). Revisions increase and name their selected predecessor. Reopening a terminal task as pending or in progress requires `reopen_reason`.
